# up esbuild

Move the `esbuild` pin in the Go toolset to v0.14.28, covering three upstream releases; the release notes the author collected:

- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.14.26
- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.14.27
- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.14.28

`esbuild` is a JS bundler kept in the Go toolset, installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the version pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod); the bump is a change of that pin.
